name: One iam:PassRole feeding both lambda:CreateFunction and ec2:RunInstances (two chains, both detected)
note: A single PassRole primitive is shared by two independent execution primitives. Each is its own escalation path; both must be reported, not collapsed into one.
rationale: The same iam:PassRole grant can feed either execution primitive: with lambda:CreateFunction the principal launches code under a passed role via Lambda; with ec2:RunInstances it does so via an EC2 instance profile. These are two distinct, independently exploitable paths that happen to reuse one PassRole primitive. Reporting only one would hide a real alternative route, so BOTH PASSROLE-LAMBDA and PASSROLE-EC2 must be detected. Ref: AWS docs, iam:PassRole with ec2:RunInstances and with lambda:CreateFunction (each service consumes the passed role independently).
